limitations: All240 original/new rows and210 original adjacent case rows remain. Worst-of-five observable envelopes are explicitly supplemental diagnostics, not confidence intervals or continuum error bounds. Figures use shared physical tetrahedron-count axes, original raw unaveraged maxima and zero-preserving symlog changes. Actual initial text-QA failure, inspected colour/monochrome previews, editable text SVGs, decoded TrueType PDFs and real1000dpi PNGs remain. Geometry/volume/contact axes and every original completion gate stay open. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
